note: Host config of the capture.qcqa_library live check (live check ``capture.qcqa_library``): only the SharePoint part of examples/host.live-check.json (the same scope, examples/sharepoint_capture_scope.qcqa_library.json, and the same audiences, so host.cycles serves the same capture), with a smaller budget_seconds so the check's three cycles (each bounded by it: 3 x 400 s) and its coverage listing (bounded by its own census_budget_seconds, 3600 s, never by the capture's) plus the projections, the trim and one OCR overrun per cycle fit the check's 5400 s timeout. A walk the budget cuts resumes in the next cycle, so the three cycles read up to 1200 s of the library; a library larger than that stays partial, recorded incomplete (sharepoint_coverage.complete false), never complete, until the check's named state (--state-name qcqa-library) carries the walk and the census across runs. Configuration, never a grant.
